title: Projected Stochastic Momentum Methods for Nonlinear Equality-Constrained Optimization for Machine Learning
summary: Two algorithms are proposed, analyzed, and tested for solving continuous optimization problems with nonlinear equality constraints. Each is an extension of a stochastic momentum-based method from the unconstrained setting to the setting of a stochastic Newton-SQP-type algorithm for solving equality-constrained problems. One is an extension of the heavy-ball method and the other is an extension of the Adam optimization method. Convergence guarantees for the algorithms for the constrained setting are provided that are on par with state-of-the-art guarantees for their unconstrained…
